AUTHOR: Poling
TITLE: Annotation strategy trade-offs for deep learning-based underwater fish detection
REGION: Southern and western Norwegian coast; Skagerrak and Kattegat, Sweden
SPECIES: Labrids (Labrus bergylta, L. mixtus, Symphodus melops, Ctenolabrus rupestris, Centrolabrus exoletus), gadids (Gadus morhua incl. YOY, haddock, pollack, saithe, whiting, poor cod), Squalus acanthias, gobies, ling, decapods
DATA: FjordFish dataset (own BRUV/RUV surveys 2018-2024): 3,002 images / 6,350 annotations; separate test set 200 images from unseen, more recent survey videos
V_EV: Sec. 2.2: 'Footage is primarily captured in shallow water (0–30 m)'; Sec. 4.2: gadids 'were more common in more turbid conditions in this dataset'
D2: Final models: expert-curated 2/3 train, 1/3 val (not spatially separated); test set 200 images from previously unseen videos; model selection by 6-fold 75/25 random image CV
D_EV: Sec. 2.4 p.4: 'All sorting for both split types was done without accounting for sample location or station'; Sec. 4.2 p.7: 'This introduces a risk of data leakage' (headline = validation on image-level expert split)
R_EV: Sec. 2.2: test set 'include annotations from unseen videos from more recent rounds of surveys ... distinct new conditions'; Table 4 reports validation F1 and test-set F1 (e.g. Gadids 0.691 vs 0.427)
E_EV: Table 3/4: only detection metrics (mAP(50–95), recall, F1); Sec. 4.3: comparison with human annotation on full videos left to future work
ARCH: YOLOv8m/x, YOLOv9c/e, YOLOv10b/x, YOLO11l/x; YOLOv9c selected; generalist vs specialist (gadids, labrids, sharks) detectors
METR: mAP(50–95), recall, precision, F1, stability/efficiency ranking, beta regression of F1 on annotations
NOTE: Abstract headline numbers are validation results on the image-level expert split (leakage explicitly acknowledged) -> D1 image-level, D_ALL P. Separate test set from unseen videos of more recent survey rounds (test compiled 2026; main data 2018-2024) with new backgrounds; coded as external (later survey period) with in-domain vs test F1 reported -> R_ALL Y. Verifier should check whether these 'more recent rounds' count as a different season/year (P2) — if judged same campaign, R1 = N and the test set would instead support D1 = video. Some cod annotations from a semi-natural mesocosm at Flodevigen. Confidence threshold not reported (standard Ultralytics validation). Inter-annotator agreement reported (0.919) but not an E-type comparison. Habitat mix: kelp, rocky reef, eelgrass, unvegetated (coded 온대 암반/켈프).
